title: Predict construction order
prompt: Implement `class Parent` with a constructor printing `parent` and a destructor printing `~parent`, and `class Child : public Parent` whose constructor prints `child` and destructor prints `~child`. Use std::cout exactly (no extra text). The test captures construction/destruction inside a scope.

tests.name: order
tests.code:
std::string out = capture([]() { Child c; });
CHECK_LINES(out, "parent", "child", "~child", "~parent");
tests.hint: capture() returns what was printed; construction is base-first, destruction reversed.

tests.name: reverse
tests.hint: The captured order is exactly the construction order.
